_note: Template for build_group_prompts.py and build_group_viewer.py. groups_dir holds the outputs of the deterministic steps (effect matrix, groups, promoter screen, evidence); paths are relative to this file unless absolute. Settings match the ProgramAnnotatorV3 config of the same screen. Drop `conditions` for a single-condition screen. condition_design: "unordered" (default; stimuli, donors, cohorts) or "ordered" (timepoints, a dose series).

conditions.label: C1
conditions.description: what distinguishes this condition, e.g. day 1 / IFNG / donor A

settings.cell_system: the cell system and state, as a reader should see it
settings.effect_label: what the effect matrix holds, as an axis label; default log2FC (e.g. Calibrated t-statistic)
settings.significance_label: how program effects were called, e.g. CRT adjusted p < 0.05 per condition
settings.annotation_role: the specialist the model should act as, e.g. developmental biologist
settings.condition_variable: what the conditions vary, e.g. timepoint, cytokine stimulus, donor, genotype
